title: Tenant-boundary sampling and log redaction for private deployments
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Implement a robust sampling decision propagation mechanism and tenant-aware log redaction pipeline for Dedicated and Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments. Goal is to preserve trace-context fidelity across perimeter collectors and internal forwarders while minimizing cross-tenant privacy leakage in logs and traces.
background: Customers running Redwood Private have reported partial traces and noisy billing/alerts when perimeter collectors independently sample spans. Additionally, certain debug logs forwarded from customer bridges can include tenant PII or secrets when not scrubbed consistently. Current collector behavior allows sampling decisions to be dropped or re-evaluated downstream, and log redaction rules are inconsistent between hosted and private collectors.
proposal: 1) Enforce a propagated sampling decision header (rd-sample) carried through perimeter -> ingress -> internal collectors and preserved by our forwarders. 2) Add deterministic sampling fingerprinting for high-cardinality customer requests so downstream components can decide consistently. 3) Introduce a tenant-aware log scrubber chain with ordered rules: schema normalization -> tenant-specific allowlists/deny-lists -> regex redaction -> structured field masking. 4) Expose sampling and redaction diagnostics in the Console (per-tenant sampling rate, fraction of traces with re-evaluated sample decisions, counts of redacted fields) and emit metrics for SLA dashboards.
out_of_scope: Modifying third-party customer-side agents or forcing sampling behavior inside customer networks. Full re-architecture of tracing format or protocol (OTLP v1 -> v2 conversion) unless minimally required to carry rd-sample header.
acceptance_criteria: Perimeter collector attaches rd-sample header with sampling decision for all outgoing spans/requests 99% of the time in integration tests
Downstream ingress and internal collectors preserve rd-sample header and do not re-sample unless explicitly configured
Deterministic sampling fingerprint reduces variance for identical request fingerprints across replicas (95th percentile variance < 2%)
Log scrubber pipeline redacts configured sensitive patterns and respects tenant-specific allowlists; verified by automated golden-file tests
Console shows per-tenant sampling rate and a metric for 're-evaluated_sampling_count' within 48h of rollout
E2E test with a simulated multi-tenant on-prem cluster demonstrates no cross-tenant log leakage in 5000 synthetic requests
implementation_notes: Add rd-sample and rd-fingerprint headers to perimeter collector output path; fall back to OTLP attribute when header unavailable
Implement a sampler module in ingress service that honors rd-sample unless operator config permits override for maintenance windows
Pipeline operator can supply tenant redaction config via k8s ConfigMap or Secrets for on-prem installs
Provide a dry-run mode for redaction rules that emits 'redaction_preview' metric and sample payloads to a secure audit bucket for engineers
Unit tests for fingerprint hashing must be stable across languages and node restarts (use murmur3 with seed)
risks: Header bloat and increased request size for high-traffic collectors; monitor latency impact
Incorrect redaction rules could break structured logs consumed by downstream analytic jobs; include opt-in allowlist and schema validators
Deterministic fingerprinting may accidentally correlate across tenants if fingerprint inputs are not properly namespaced; ensure tenant id and salt are included
Operators may incorrectly configure aggressive sampling overrides during incidents causing observability gaps
dependencies: ENG-75201 (private-collector-config-api): config API to push tenant redaction rules
ENG-70344 (ingress-scaling): ingress capacity changes to handle added header traffic
PM-412 (privacy-compliance-audit): schedule for audit and legal review of redaction policies
notes: Sync'd with Solutions Engineering to validate tenant redact rules for three early customers (Acme, Finlytics, HealthCo)
Proposed rollout: feature-flag the sampling propagation first, enable dry-run redaction for 2 weeks, then switch to enforced mode for customers who opt-in
